name: Scout the hills
text: Two hunters climb the ridge to see what lies beyond the valley.
mishap: One of the party did not come back.

finds.text: They found a berry thicket on the way home.

name: Follow the river
text: Three travelers follow the river downstream, toward the River Clan's grounds.
mishap: One of the party did not come back.

finds.text: The River Clan traded news with them, and trust grew.
They found a stand of fruit trees.

name: Gather mushrooms
text: A small party searches the damp woods for the mushrooms the River Clan showed you. Which ones are safe? Nobody is sure.

finds.text: Visions around the fire that night, and new ideas by morning.
Some of the pickers were sick for days.
The wrong mushroom. One of the pickers died.
